# Tiny on-device AI models (~43MB class) as a Chaba front-end preprocessor

**Deep Research report** — Gemini `deep-research-preview-04-2026` · 2026-09-27
· 46 grounded searches · ~2.26M input tokens · ~13 min runtime · est. $1–3

---



### 5.2 The Economics and Calibration of Escalation

The economic impact of this architecture is profound. Routine tool-selection and routing calls to cloud APIs accumulate massive costs at scale. By intercepting 80% to 90% of basic commands locally, a $30 CPU server can effectively replace tens of thousands of dollars in monthly API costs, while simultaneously preserving user privacy for routine domestic queries [cite: 3, 56].

However, the safety of this routing relies entirely on the calibration of the local model's confidence score. Relying strictly on the model's standard output probability distribution is insufficient, as modern LLMs—especially those heavily quantized—are notoriously overconfident on out-of-distribution prompts [cite: 40]. System engineers must enforce explicit verbalized confidence elicitation. This technique forces the model to mathematically rationalize its intent decision and append a numerical probability before finalizing its JSON output, ensuring that ambiguous or complex queries reliably fall below the confidence threshold and are safely handed off to the cloud [cite: 41].

## 6. Comprehensive Benchmark Plan

To validate the deployment of a 50MB model for this semantic routing task, a rigorous, multi-tiered benchmark plan must be executed prior to production. The evaluation must capture the nuanced trade-offs between ultra-low quantization, NLU accuracy, and deterministic hardware performance [cite: 57, 58].

| Benchmark Phase | Target Metric | Methodology & Datasets | Success Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Phase 1: NLU Accuracy** | Intent Accuracy | Utilize subsets of `Banking77` and `TREC` to test the model's ability to map diverse phrasings into a rigid taxonomy [cite: 30, 31]. Evaluate Thai dialect robustness using `SEACrowd` [cite: 44]. | $> 90\%$ accuracy on constrained local intents. Minimal degradation on Thai queries. |
| **Phase 1: Extraction** | Slot $F1_{\text{micro}}$-Score | Utilize `LLMStructBench` to test JSON generation [cite: 42]. Apply a heavier penalty ($\alpha = 0.25$) to false values over incorrect keys [cite: 42]. | $> 85\%$ F1 score with grammar-constrained decoding enabled in `llama.cpp`. |
| **Phase 2: Calibration** | Expected Calibration Error (ECE) | Measure the discrepancy between self-reported verbalized confidence and actual accuracy across 2,000 randomized queries [cite: 40, 41]. | ECE $< 10\%$. Establish an optimal escalation threshold ($\tau$) to minimize false positives. |
| **Phase 3: Latency** | TTFT & p95 Latency | Deploy the GGUF model via `llama.cpp` on the target hardware (Raspberry Pi 5 and Intel N150 iGPU). Measure Time to First Token (TTFT) and total generation time [cite: 53]. | p95 latency $< 200$ milliseconds for a complete 5-token payload. |
| **Phase 3: Hardware** | Peak RAM Consumption | Utilize memory profilers to monitor the peak footprint during context loading and the KV-cache expansion phase [cite: 57, 59]. | Strict adherence to the 50MB physical constraint under active conversational load. |

## 7. Conclusion

Deploying a functional Large Language Model within a strict 50MB envelope for on-device voice processing is mathematically and operationally achievable, provided engineering teams abandon traditional deployment methodologies. While foundational architectures like Qwen2.5-0.5B and Gemma 3 270M offer immense dense intelligence, applying standard 4-bit quantization leaves them far above the memory target. 

Success dictates the hybridization of advanced compression techniques: combining ultra-low-bit Imatrix quantization (1.5-bit to 2-bit) with aggressive embedding layer pruning to remove dead cross-lingual tokens. When structured through this rigorous pipeline and executed via highly optimized runtimes like `llama.cpp`, these micro-models operate as exceptional semantic routers. By leveraging prompt-based confidence elicitation to escalate complex queries to the cloud, systems can execute local commands instantly and privately while seamlessly relying on frontier models for complex dialogue, perfectly optimizing the balance between edge computing economics, privacy, and state-of-the-art capability.

# tony-omen shutdown assessment

Assessment of what survives, degrades, or breaks while tony-omen is down —
run during the 2026-09-27 reboot window (zram 12G→24G, NVML driver fix,
post-migration validation). Ada + Devin collaboration.

## Ada's half (memory recall)

Ada's memory banks held only partial, partially-stale knowledge of omen's
role — she identified it as primarily an MDDB/AI-services host (MDDB actually
lives on idc01). The 2026-09-27 service migration had not yet distilled into
her banks. Finding: **recall quality gap** for same-day infra changes; the
live facts below are authoritative.

Desktop sessions, the yolo-xiaomi camera detector, the weaviate MiniLM
embedding service, weaviate-search API + nightly indexer, ollama, the

# Transcript audit — 2026-09-28 evening sessions

Evidence: idc01 journals + ~/.local/share/ada/transcripts. Sessions reviewed:
`286997a533` (18:17), `30df7726fc` (18:03), `cf25e5de69` (18:22),
`d5f0c2ffca` (18:26), `ac1fe3abda` (18:35–18:46), `5c342398b5` (19:13–19:14).

## Finding 1 — Phantom cast/display claims (FIXED, f15752d)

Session `ac1fe3abda` 18:45: Ada said "วิดีโอวอลล์จราจร แสดงผลบนสกรีน 3
เรียบร้อยแล้ว" and later "ภาพจากกล้องวงจรปิดเครื่องซักผ้า แสดงผลบนสกรีน 3
แล้วนะครับ" — **zero tool calls in the journal for the whole 18:35–18:47
window** (both ada-ha units checked). She asked for confirmation, got
"yes", then announced success without calling `cast_to_screen` or
`cctv_snapshot` at all. Worst class of bug — the user trusts it happened.

Fixes shipped (ada-pi f15752d):
- `_PHANTOM_CLAIM_RE` extended to display/cast completion claims
  (EN "now showing on screen"/"on screen 3"; TH "แสดงผล…แล้ว",
  "ขึ้นจอ…แล้ว", "ส่งไปที่จอ…เรียบร้อย"). Verified on the real utterances;
  offers ("อยากให้แสดงผลบนจอไหม") and intent ("กำลังจะส่งไปที่จอ") don't
  false-positive.
- `DEFAULT_ADA_INSTRUCTIONS` "DONE MEANS DONE" rule: never announce a
  screen/cast/capture as done unless the tool returned success this turn.

## Finding 2 — Traffic-camera call storm on dead cams (FIXED)

Session `5c342398b5` 19:13–19:14: **13 `traffic_camera` calls** — every
Pattaya/Chonburi match hit the iTIC 43-byte dead-frame stub and each
retry cost a full tool roundtrip. Fixes live: feed suspension filter
(`X.X.X.X`/`tempsus` placeholder records never become candidates),
provider walks up to 4 ranked candidates inside one call, suspended-area
queries return an honest "N matched but suspended" marker.

## Finding 3 — Geo-only traffic query always failed (FIXED, f15752d)

`traffic_camera(lat=…, lon=…)` with no keyword/heading always returned
"no match": distance subtracted from a zero base made every score <0.
Now `+60 − min(dist,100)` — verified: geo-only @BKK returns 5 ranked,
nearest 3.2 km; heading east/west both rank correctly.

## Finding 4 — Unverified "latest data" presented as fact (OPEN)

`d5f0c2ffca`: zero tool calls, yet Ada reported "จากข้อมูลล่าสุด" flood
details for Phayao/ม.พะเยา and self-contradicted Mae Sot distance
(200+ km → 70–80 km between adjacent turns). Candidate fix: instruction
to age-hedge model-memory claims ("ล่าสุดที่ผมรู้") unless a tool
confirms. Not yet shipped.

## Finding 5 — Speaker-ID still muddies identity (OPEN, known)

`ac1fe3abda`: KK enrolled mid-session; Ada then confused KK ↔ "คุณเซ" ↔
Tony across turns. Same root as memory-audit sticky-identity.

## Finding 6 — STT hallucinates languages on noise (OPEN, known)

PT/ES/KO/HI/ZH fragments logged as user turns on unclear audio. Ada
recovers gracefully; speaker-gate remains the open fix.

## Finding 7 — Silent clobbering of busy screens (FIXED, 0b15457)

`ac1fe3abda` + `30df7726fc`: Ada bounced screen 3 between God's Eye View
and the traffic wall, and flipped it to a CCTV snap — never acknowledging
she was replacing a running flow. `vcast_list` already carried the
ground truth (state, active_captures, camwall_zones) but cast_to_screen
reported it only *after* the publish.

Shipped (ada-pi 0b15457):
- `cast_to_screen` nav/play/image/audio/uplink onto a busy screen
  (capture lease, enabled camwall zone, or 'playing') returns
  `would_interrupt` + `needs_confirm` and does NOT publish; the retry
  needs `confirmed=true`, which only survives if the user's own speech
  affirmed (the confirm-stripping gate already enforced this — observed
  live blocking a self-certified `confirmed=True` on screen 2).
- Successful casts/walls that replaced something carry `replaced` —
  Ada must acknowledge aloud what was interrupted.
- Found along the way: `cctv_wall`'s declared schema lacked the
  `confirmed` param — Gemini rejected the flag so the confirm flow
  could never complete ("that tool doesn't accept it"). Fixed.
- Regression: `cast-interrupt-gate` scenario, in the casting suite —
  PASS live (gate refused, ask happened, yes → delivered + replaced,
  stop torn down).

## Environment notes

- Estate P2P (noble-a/noble-club via XMEye cloud) fully down — all panes
  "no video", snaps 503 after ~34 s; VMS restart didn't recover.
  Consistent with flood damage; honest-503 path verified.
- iTIC feed this morning: 36 live / 152 suspended of 188; of live-flagged
  only ~40% return real frames (rest are 43 B stubs / fixed 3 KB
  "No signal" jpegs). ~10–15 usable cams, all Bangkok/Nonthaburi.
- A second agent session was deploying ada-pi on idc01 during the bench
  (restarts at 07:38/07:40) — killed two scenario retries mid-run;
  deployed files verified to still match this branch afterwards.
- camwall zones seen enabled during the day: `rama9`→screen 2
  (since 09-28 13:53, leftover demo), `traffic`→screen 2 (later). The
  interrupt gate now protects these from silent clobbering.
- Screens 1 & 3 (iPads) were offline during the run — screen-1-targeted
  scenarios can't get delivered:1.

# Transcript audit — 2026-09-29 (CCTV latency + voice-ID deadlock)

## What Tony reported
"Still slow on cctv operations." Sessions: 06134715fd (wall casts), c66a8409e3 + 6b1005bb28 (voice enroll deadlock).

## Root causes found

1. **Wall start took 3 round-trips**: "send a wall" -> "which zone?" -> "confirm?" -> starts. Tony: "just go ahead, stop asking confirm." The capture-confirm gate fired even when the USER explicitly requested the wall — their ask IS the consent.
2. **Blank-wall blindness**: zone-a/noble-park walls cast fine but rendered empty (VMS P2P down -> all cams dead). Ada kept insisting "system says the wall is up" because she had no live-cam feedback. User saw "single camera and no picture", then "no table" on a traffic wall too.
3. **Voice-ID deadlock**: Tony's voice identified as KK (his print is stale/poisoned — code comment records "Tony's voice overwrote 'KK' after a borderline misidentification"). Both speaker_id guards then refused his genuine voice: contamination guard (matches KK) + own-voice check (doesn't match stale Tony print). ada_forget_speaker doesn't exist — no recovery path at all.
4. **Non-atomic wall writes**: a page fetch during puller write could read a truncated manifest/jpg -> "no manifest" / half frames.

## Fixes shipped

- **Owner-aware capture gate** (tool_runner._check_capture_confirmed): confirmed=true only required on secondary (recognized non-owner) turns. Owner explicitly asking = consent. Tool descriptions updated: "the request IS the consent — do not re-ask."
- **Wall health on start**: cctv_wall start now returns live_cams/total_cams + note_extra ("ALL cameras down — warn the user"). Ada can say "0/5 live, DVR uplink down" immediately instead of the user discovering a blank wall.
- **Enroll force path**: ada_enroll_speaker(confirmed=true) -> enroll_from_buffer(force) -> enroll(force) replaces the profile outright, skipping contamination + own-voice guards. Only allowed when target == session owner. Unlocks Tony's deadlock: say "fix my voiceprint", confirm, done.
- **Atomic writes**: manifest-*.json + thumbs write to .tmp then os.replace — page never reads half a file.
- **Wall page HUD**: when 0 cams live -> "all N cams down — showing stale/err" instead of a silent empty grid.
- **Split-screen panes** (earlier same session): layout 2-5, pane-routed casts, zoom/unzoom, per-pane stop; relay lastCast pane-keyed; registry tracks panes=N for pane-aware busy gating. split-screen scenario passed live.
- **Tool-name normalization**: c_c_t_v_wall -> cctv_wall (Gemini spells underscore names phonetically).

## Still open

- Tony's voiceprint must be re-enrolled once with the force path (then KK may need re-enroll if she still collides).
- VMS/XMEye P2P still down -> zone-a, noble-park, vms-* walls have 0 live cams.
- tony-house go2rtc returns 0B frames; chonburi HLS sources all dead.
- First-turn greeting race still occasionally eats turn 1 of scenarios.

## Report chain
transcript-audit-2026-09-28 (phantom claims, geo bug, interrupt gate) -> this.

# User Education — Correction Duty Policy

Status: **active** · adopted 2026-09-28 · enforced in CI

## What the policy is

Devin and Ada both carry a standing duty: **correct the operator plainly
when he asserts something factually wrong, misremembers a prior
decision, or proposes a wrong direction — accuracy over agreeableness.**
When a request rests on a misunderstanding, briefly explain the right
model instead of silently complying. Verify real state before
correcting; the duty is to be right, not contrarian.

## Where it lives (keep all three in sync)

| layer | location | mechanism |
|---|---|---|
| Ada | `DEFAULT_ADA_INSTRUCTIONS` → Personality block, `backend/realtime_provider.py` (ada-pi) | system instruction injected per session |
| Devin | `AGENTS.md` → "Operator correction & education duty" (chaba) | repo rules, loaded every session |
| CI | `education_correction` scenario — `tools` suite, smoke tier | hourly regression test |

## How it is tested

`education_correction` runs in the hourly smoke suite. It feeds Ada a
**false premise** ("ada_v2 used YOLO for the cursor, right?") and a
**wrong-direction proposal** ("I'll drive the pointer from YOLO bounding
boxes"). Passing = she corrects toward MediaPipe landmarks both times
and never agrees. Failing surfaces on the `auto-report` page.

## Extending the coverage

Add a turn (or a new scenario) whenever a real correction incident
happens: phrase the trap the way the misunderstanding actually occurred,
assert the correct mechanism must be named, assert agreement phrases
must not appear. Domain sources that work well: kb-system docs, SSOT,
scenario/benchmark history — anything Ada can ground from a real
searchable fact.

## Why it exists

Sycophancy is the default failure mode of assistants — agreeing is cheap
and wrong. This policy makes correction contractual *and* continuously
verified, so it survives model updates.

_Updated by hand or by the benchmark runner; this page describes policy
state, not runtime data. Last verified: 2026-09-28 10:04._

# vcast playback failure — incident report

### Incident Report: vcast Playback Failure
**Time:** 2026-09-25 19:12
**User:** Tony
**Details:** User reported vcast screen 1 (iPad) showed black screen and
did not play video even after refresh and re-sending playback command.
System status indicated 'playing', but no visual output was observed on
the device.
**Devin Task:** Dispatched to investigate and fix playback issue, verify
with tests, and generate final report.

---

### Update — 2026-09-27

**Status: partially resolved — cast path hardened, black-screen root cause fixed in the tool layer.**

Findings and fixes since the incident:

- **Root cause class: tool-layer silent failure.** The cast *worked*
  server-side while status read 'playing' — iPad showed nothing because
  the action verb returned before the player attached. Two steering bugs
  made it look like a playback fault: `tv_action` was also answering
  lookup questions (cast instead of answer), and the HA client timed out
  at 5s while `nav`/cast takes ~6–10s.
- **Fixed**: `ha_client` per-call timeout raised to 45s (`a269fe9`) —
  the cast-complete response no longer aborts mid-flight; `tv_action` is
  now screen-display only (`b412b4a`); news lookups route to
  `web_search` (`42bc8c1`, `1f33052` for the grounding-quota revert).
- **Owner-locked casting** (`6a2ced7`, `5024c07`, `6b27155`): screens
  are speaker-gated — a guest/kid can't take over Tony's screen;
  `/pub` confirms via `ok:true` without echoing denial.
- **`cctv_snapshot`** (`f2e5951`): single-frame go2rtc peek pushed to a
  screen — gives Ada "eyes" on what a vcast screen actually shows
  (peek-per-request, no streaming overhead).
- **`/api/notify`** (`f9a5b49`): the backend can inject a system turn
  into the live voice session — cast results/ETA announcements reach
  Ada even when the action originated outside the conversation.
- **Scenario coverage**: `tv_cast_control.yaml` exercises cast verbs
  live; `cctv_snapshot_to_screen.yaml` covers the peek path.

**Still open:**

- [ ] vcast mechanics + remote-browser live verification on tony-dell
      (end-to-end play → iPad actually renders — not just status flags)
- [ ] A "did the screen show it?" post-cast check — `cctv_snapshot` of
      the target screen after cast to close the loop
- [ ] iPad black-screen device-side check (browser console) — only if it
      recurs after the tool-layer fixes

# Yomi vs LINE bot

Two distinct LINE-related services are active in this system. Do not confuse them.

### Yomi (Message Archive)
Yomi **reads** and **analyzes** LINE chats. It pulls conversations, generates summaries, and makes them searchable.

- **Purpose:** Archiving and searching past conversations.

### LINE bot (Notifications)
The LINE bot **writes** and **sends** messages. It handles outbound alerts and notifications to the user.

- **Purpose:** Sending system notices and reminders.

---
**Rule of thumb:** Yomi reads, the bot writes.
